Class Radio<T>

java.lang.Object
com.trevlar.menukit.core.AbstractPanelElement<Radio<T>>
com.trevlar.menukit.core.Radio<T>
Type Parameters:
T - the value type of this Radio and its group (typically an enum)
All Implemented Interfaces:
PanelElement
public class Radio<T> extends AbstractPanelElement<Radio<T>>
A single-selection control. One of a set of Radios coordinated by a shared RadioGroup. Clicking selects this Radio's value in the group; Radios render their own checked state by comparing their value against the group's current selection.

Auto-sizes from label content: total width is BOX_SIZE + LABEL_GAP + fontWidth(label); height is BOX_SIZE. Consumers do not pass width or height at construction.

Clicking anywhere within the element bounds (square OR label area) selects this Radio's value in the group.

Mutable state (via coordinator)

Radio's checked state is derived from the RadioGroup's currently selected value. The group holds the mutable state; each Radio reads it at render time. See RadioGroup for the architectural exception and its scope.

Dynamic-width limitation with supplier labels

Auto-sizing elements with supplier-based variable content cannot guarantee layout stability — if the supplier returns different-length text each frame, the element's width changes per frame but panel layout is not re-resolved per frame. Consumers needing stable layout should use fixed-content variants or ensure the supplier returns same-width content across all evaluations.
See Also:
  • The coordinator
  • Multi-select sibling

    • layoutWithin

      public void layoutWithin(int budget)
      Wrap the label to the panel-assigned budget. The box + gap are fixed furniture, so only the label area can flex: we subtract them off the budget and engage wrapping ONLY when that remaining label area is narrower than the label's natural single-line width. At a roomy budget the wrap is cleared (set to 0) so the Radio reports its intrinsic single-line size again — a later wider pass un-wraps it, reversibly (this is the same reversible engage/clear TextLabel uses).
      Parameters:
      budget - horizontal pixels available to this element, in panel content space. Always >= 1.

    • extraLayoutHeight

      public int extraLayoutHeight()
      Extra vertical pixels this Radio occupies BEYOND its authored box height because the label wrapped — i.e. wrappedHeight - BOX_SIZE, or 0 when not wrapped. The owning Panel reflows the elements below this one downward by exactly this amount, so a label that grows to multiple lines pushes — never paints over — what sits beneath it.

    • mouseClicked

      public boolean mouseClicked(double mouseX, double mouseY, int button)
      Description copied from interface: PanelElement
      Called when the mouse is clicked on this element. The dispatcher hit-tests against the element's bounds before calling this method, so implementations know the click is within bounds.

      Returns true if this element consumed the click (preventing further dispatch to slots or vanilla). The default returns false, so render-only elements (TextLabel, Icon, ItemDisplay) don't need to override it.

      The button parameter is the mouse button: 0=left, 1=right, 2=middle. Core Button only consumes left-click; custom elements can handle any button.

      Parameters:
      mouseX - screen-space mouse X
      mouseY - screen-space mouse Y
      button - mouse button (0=left, 1=right, 2=middle)
      Returns:
      true if consumed, false to let the click fall through
